subtitle: Know exactly where you are in your journey

stages.name: 🚀 Let's Begin!
stages.description: Welcome to the Application Zone. You're about to discover a multi-agent platform that bridges your apps with powerful AI services.

details.title: What you'll learn:
items: How to discover agents from your app
How to invoke agents with payloads
How to see results and iterate

stages.tip: Take your time. This guide adjusts to your pace.

stages.name: ⚙️ Setup Your Environment
stages.description: Start the Application Zone backend and factory portal. This creates the infrastructure for discovering and invoking agents.

details.title: What happens at this stage:
items: Application Zone backend starts listening on port 5000
Factory Portal opens in your browser on port 5501
Your app runtime connects to port [APP_PORT]
All services verify they can reach each other

stages.tip: If services don't start, check that ports 5000, 5501, and [APP_PORT] are available.
stages.landmark: Both services are running and can see each other

stages.name: 📦 Create Your First Instance
stages.description: Create an isolated workspace that connects to your app runtime and auto-discovers all agents.

details.title: What happens at this stage:
items: You provide instance configuration (name, app ID, runtime URL)
Application Zone backend loads your app's manifest
All agents are discovered and indexed
Instance is saved with your configuration

stages.tip: Don't have your app running? You can add the runtime URL later—create the instance anyway.
checklist: Click Create and see success message
stages.landmark: Instance created—you should see 'N agents discovered' in the portal

stages.name: 🔍 Discover Available Agents
stages.description: Load and explore all agents that your app exposes. Each agent solves a specific problem.

details.title: Understanding agents:
items: Agents are AI-powered workers that handle specific tasks
Each agent has a name, description, and expected input format
Agents are grouped by capability (Knowledge, Discovery, Operations, Pipeline)
You choose which agent best fits your task

stages.tip: Start with a simple agent like the 'Fallback Chat Agent' to understand the flow.
checklist: Understand which agent fits your need
stages.landmark: You can see all agents and their descriptions in the agent dropdown

stages.name: ⚡ Select & Invoke an Agent
stages.description: Build a JSON payload and invoke your first agent. See how payloads transform into results.

details.title: What happens when you invoke:
items: Your JSON payload is sent to the selected agent
The agent processes your request using its trained model
The agent returns a structured response with metadata
You see results in the output panel with citations

stages.tip: Start with the sample payload—modify it once you see how it works.
checklist: Build or paste your JSON payload
stages.landmark: You see agent response in the output panel with metadata

stages.name: 🎯 See Results & Next Steps
stages.description: Your agent has processed your request. Explore the response and try different agents.

details.title: Understanding results:
items: Each response includes the agent's answer plus metadata
Citations show which sources or knowledge the agent used
Metadata includes confidence scores and processing time
You can iterate—try different payloads or agents

stages.tip: Keep iterating! Each invocation teaches you more about how agents work.
checklist: View agent response in output panel
Explore all agents to understand their strengths
stages.landmark: You've successfully invoked multiple agents and explored their responses
